About the role
As a Test Engineer, you will work closely with the Development Team to ensure that client products are error-free and meet quality standards. You will execute testing strategies, identify issues, and support the development process to deliver seamless user experiences.

This is an existing vacancy.

In addition to base salary, the compensation package includes a bonus, stock options and benefits (including savings, healthcare, tuition reimbursement, flexible paid time off and much more).

What you'll do

Testing Execution: Develop and execute testing strategies and detailed test plans for modules and features, ensuring they meet requirements and are free from defects.
Collaborative Testing: Work with the Development Team to perform functional and regression testing during the agile release cycle.
Automation and Documentation: Contribute to the development of test automation scripts and product documentation, including test plans and training materials.
Process Support: Identify and support opportunities for improvements in development and testing processes.
Issue Identification: Detect, report, and follow up on software defects to ensure timely resolution.

What you'll bring
Hands-on experience with exploratory software testing.
Strong technical skills in testing consumer-facing SaaS applications.
Strong organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
Analytical mindset and problem-solving abilities with a focus on identifying software issues.
Familiarity with test automation frameworks and tools, including implementing automated tests
Familiarity with relational databases and SQL query development/testing.

About The Role

 Purpose

Design, develop, test, release and support secure, reliable and maintainable software that delivers useful outcomes for 7IM, its clients and colleagues. Work across the full delivery lifecycle, using modern engineering practices and approved AI-assisted tools to improve speed and quality while retaining clear human ownership, review and accountability.

Responsibilities

• Deliver well-scoped software changes in line with feature delivery in collaboration with the team.

• Write clean, maintainable and well-tested code that follows 7IM architecture, security, engineering and data standards.

• Contribute to technical discovery and design, understanding the problem behind the request and making sensible trade-offs between user value, delivery speed, risk, cost and maintainability.

• Build automated tests at the appropriate unit, integration and regression levels, and support proportionate manual testing where needed.

• Take part in peer reviews of code, designs and documentation, giving specific feedback and applying the same quality bar to manually produced and AI-generated work.

• Use approved AI coding tools, including IDE assistants, chat-based tools and coding agents, productively and responsibly. Review outputs for correctness, security, licensing, maintainability and fit before they are committed or released.

• Break work into clear tasks, specifications and prompts that allow people and tools to work effectively, with appropriate review points and traceability.

• Follow disciplined version control, pull request, CI/CD, environment and release practices. Do not bypass quality gates, peer review or operational checks.

• Add useful logging, telemetry, error handling and operational documentation so services can be monitored, diagnosed, supported and recovered.

• Support production services, contribute to incident investigation and third-line support, and follow through on fixes and learning that reduce repeat issues.

• Keep progress, risks, assumptions and blockers visible. Work closely with product, testing, architecture, cloud engineering, information security and support colleagues.

• Understand the squad's domain, users, roadmap and OKRs, and connect day-to-day engineering choices to business and client outcomes.

• Identify technical debt, repeated manual effort and weak delivery or support practices, and contribute practical improvements through automation, simplification and better tooling.

• Share knowledge through documentation, pairing, walkthroughs and constructive support for other developers.

• Work in line with 7IM's values, policies and expectations for operating in a regulated environment, including security, risk, control and traceability.

• Carry out other reasonable duties requested by your line manager or 7IM.

 About You

 Qualifications

• Relevant degree or equivalent knowledge

Skills

• Proficiency in C#, modern .NET, API design and development, SQL Server and the web technologies used by the squad. 

• Experience with Angular is preferred, although React experience is also useful.

• Working knowledge of Azure services, cloud-native delivery, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, source control and automated testing.

• Understanding of secure coding, identity and access, dependency risk, data protection, common web and API vulnerabilities, and the controls expected in a regulated financial services firm.

• Practical proficiency with AI tools for agentic development. Able to provide useful context and prompts, use repo-aware and agentic workflows where appropriate, validate generated code and tests, and recognise when AI should not be used.

• Clear understanding that AI-generated output is not trusted by default. The developer remains accountable for design choices, security, quality, licensing, testing and the production outcome.

• Ability to diagnose issues across code, configuration, deployment, data and runtime behaviour, using logs, telemetry and other operational evidence.

• Ability to break down problems, estimate with appropriate confidence, identify assumptions and dependencies, and raise risks or blockers early.

• Good written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain technical choices, trade-offs and uncertainty to technical and non-technical colleagues.

• Able to work effectively in an agile, multidisciplinary squad and take ownership through to production and support.

• Curious and willing to learn, share knowledge, respond constructively to feedback and improve how the team delivers.

Other relevant information

• Practical, collaborative and accountable approach.

• Good judgement and attention to detail, without losing sight of the outcome.

• Comfortable taking responsibility, asking for help and challenging weak assumptions constructively.

• Committed to ongoing development across engineering practice, domain knowledge and modern tooling.

• Reports to a Lead Software Developer.

Accenture's Finance Reinvention Partner helps CFOs and finance leaders reinvent how finance creates and protects enterprise value - bringing together strategy, operating model, data, AI and technology to improve performance, insight, control and execution. Planning and finance foundations. Experience participating in or supporting a budgeting, forecasting or long-range planning process, with an understanding of how operational drivers affect the income statement, balance sheet and cash flow. Requirements and process analysis. The ability to document planning calendars, activities, roles, controls, systems and data flows; gather requirements through interviews and workshops; and converts findings into clear process maps, user stories and functional documentation.

Data and performance insight. Strong numerical and analytical skills, with experience preparing, reconciling and validating data; investigating actual-to-plan variances; and developing reports or dashboards that explain performance and support decisions.

Products and Resources or similar industry understanding. Experience or project exposure within Products and/or Resources organisations, ideally where planning is influenced by demand, production, assets, projects, workforce, supply chain or capital expenditure.

Predictive planning and machine-learning awareness. An understanding of how predictive forecasting, trend analysis, anomaly detection and machine learning can support planning, together with the curiosity to test outputs, question assumptions and explain how insights should be used.

Collaborative delivery skills. The ability to work effectively across finance, business, data and technology teams, produce clear client-ready outputs, manage your own commitments and communicate progress, risks and findings with confidence.

What you'll be accountable for

Document current planning processes, calendars, roles, systems, controls, data flows and pain points using interviews, workshops and available evidence.
Gather and analyse business requirements, translating them into process maps, user stories, functional requirements and model-design inputs.
Analyse financial and operational data to identify key drivers, trends, dependencies and opportunities to improve planning and performance insight.

Support data preparation, migration, integration, reconciliation, system testing, user acceptance testing and defect resolution, ensuring outputs are complete and traceable.

PURPOSE OF THE ROLE

A role in TST sits at the heart of matter delivery, working across multiple practice areas to make the delivery of legal work more efficient, consistent and innovative. The TST team members support fee earners on live transactions and disputes by managing core process and document tasks, designing and running workflows, and operationalising legal technology platforms.
The role offers broad cross practice exposure, early responsibility and clear impact on how matters are delivered, while building highly transferable skills in project management, process improvement, innovation (including legal technology) and client communication.

The work that comes into the team is varied and no two days will be the same. You would be working with our Real Estate team. As a Transaction Real Estate paralegal, you would take instructions and primarily be supporting our [group] fee earners but also have the benefit of being part of the wider TST team.

THE TEAM

Launched in 2010, our well-established, high performing and busy Transaction Services Team (TST) help Addleshaw Goddard deliver a world class service to its clients. We were the first team of its kind in the UK and continue to innovate by delivering work in the most efficient way, saving our clients time and money. We are now one of the Firm's biggest divisions, with our team being made up of apprentices, paralegals, managers and solicitors.

Our team members focus on tasks that are found in a wide variety of legal assignments, but which do not necessarily need to be done by qualified lawyers, including process elements of transactional, advisory and contentious work. We use technology to deliver our work, which plays a key role in enabling Addleshaw Goddard to respond to client demand for more innovative and better value services. Innovation is key to how the Firm has evolved and adapted, and we aim to adopt a growth mindset in approaching tasks

Aside from a competitive salary and flexible benefits package, you'll get fantastic opportunities to support some of the UK's largest businesses, as well as the potential for exciting internal and client secondments. With our focus on continuous development and progression, we created a career development framework and training programme specifically for the TST.

As part of that framework, you'll have the opportunity to have a career conversation every 6 months to ensure we're supporting you to meet your development goals and to discuss your progression. In addition, you'll have access to our internal training contract application process, legal qualification sponsorship, SQE sponsorship and management or technical development programmes.

WHAT TO EXPECT IN THIS ROLE

To be successful in this role, the successful candidate will:

•    drafting and producing legal documentation and standard forms
•    checking legal documents for quality, consistency and content
•    managing electronic data sites, uploading and ordering documentation, and liaising with third parties
•    providing support to our clients on-site
•    any additional tasks as required by the business

•    any additional tasks as required by the business

AREAS OF KNOWLEDGE AND EXPERTISE

•    a high level of attention to detail
•    effective personal, organisational and time management skills, and the ability to juggle multiple demands
•    strong written and verbal communication skills, demonstrating an ability to communicate with colleagues at all levels
•    a positive, enthusiastic and proactive approach to work
•    a strong work ethic and a desire to develop and succeed
•    the ability to work to tight timescales with a sense of urgency
•    common sense, commerciality and the ability to exercise sound judgment
•    demonstration of a proactive interest in legal technology and innovation, with the ability to leverage tools to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service delivery.

Previous paralegal or specifically Real Estate/ Transactional Real Estate paralegal experience is desirable, but not essential.

Job Description
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Senior Static Stress Engineer to join the Wing Analysis Engineering team at Filton.
Are you passionate about developing wing structures and collaborating across multidisciplinary teams? We are a team of structural engineers, technical experts, and project managers committed to delivering innovative technical solutions to support wing analysis across our aircraft programs.

How you will contribute

• Structural Integrity & Authorisation: Lead the resolution of complex static stress challenges, acting as an approval signatory and progressing toward full structural authorisation for critical wing deliverables.
• Certification & Methodology: Define, validate, and revise the core assumptions, sizing rules, and analytical methods used to certify Outer Wing structures to CS-25 airworthiness standards.
• Regulatory & Technical Liaison: Serve as a primary technical focal point representing Wing Engineering to Technical Authorities, Chief Engineering, and Airworthiness Bodies (such as EASA).
• Cross-Disciplinary Innovation: Introduce advanced engineering solutions, best practices, and modern ways of working drawn from aerospace, adjacent high-tech industries, or cutting-edge research environments.
• Strategic Product Direction: Shape wing product strategy from a static analysis perspective, identifying and deploying digital process improvements, automated sizing tools, and structural weight-saving opportunities.
• Technical Mentorship: Drive the technical capability of the team by coaching engineers in both first-principles stress analysis and technical decision-making. 

About You

We are looking for candidates with the following skills and competences:
• Signatory Credentials: Established track record as a Static Stress Approval signatory, with the competence and background to attain full structural Authorisation.
• Methods & Toolsets: Detailed working knowledge of static stress methods and tools (including ISAMI, GISEH, and Nastran/HyperWorks), backed by solid classical hand-calculation fundamentals.
• Leadership & Delivery: Proven experience steering engineering work packages to cost, quality, and schedule milestones while championing creative problem-solving and innovation.
• Stakeholder Influence: Skilled at navigating complex, multi-functional stakeholder networks to align technical airworthiness requirements with customer and programme expectations.
• Communication: Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical data clearly for decision-making and reviews.

job_description:
Every package Amazon delivery depends on an accurate transit time estimate. The
Transit Time Authority (TTA) program is the single source of truth that vends
those estimates to internal customers across design, scheduling, routing, Amazon
Fulfilled Network, and Amazon Freight. As Amazon invests heavily in accelerating
same-day and next-day delivery, TTA plays a critical role in making that speed
possible. As a Sr Product Manager on this team, you will own the downstream
integration of transit-time models into scheduling and routing systems. You will
partner with tech and science teams to translate increasingly accurate
transit-time data into real operational improvements, driving trade-off
decisions between speed, cost, and delivery accuracy that shape how the network
performs. This role sits alongside a second Product Manager who owns the
upstream model development, giving you a clear scope focused on adoption, system
integration, and measurable business outcomes for internal customers across
network design, planning, and operations.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product strategy for integrating transit-time model outputs into
downstream scheduling and routing systems, defining requirements and priorities
based on business impact and operational data.
- Evaluate technical proposals across ML model design, system integrations, and
data pipelines, ensuring trade-off decisions between speed, cost, and delivery
accuracy are well-informed and clearly communicated.
- Lead cross-functional delivery with tech, science, and business partners,
driving alignment across teams with different priorities and influencing
strategic direction.
- Maintain TTA infrastructure for EU. Identify opportunities to apply generative
AI tools to accelerate insight generation, automate analytics workflows, and
improve team productivity while applying responsible AI practices.
- Define success criteria and performance metrics for transit-time adoption,
monitor operational health post-launch and benefits, and drive continuous
improvement through data analysis and stakeholder feedback.

You might start your morning reviewing transit-time performance dashboards and
flagging anomalies that need investigation. From there, you could join a working
session with scheduling and routing engineers to define integration requirements
for a new model granularity. After lunch, you prepare a trade-off proposal for
business stakeholders, quantifying how a change in transit-time strategy would
affect cost and delivery speed. Later, you sync with the science team on an
upcoming model update and draft acceptance criteria for the next release.

The Transit Time Authority team provides the transit-time inputs that power
scheduling, routing, and network design across Amazon's middle-mile network. We
work directly with North American tech and science teams to improve model
accuracy and expand coverage to new business flows. The organization is
investing in speed, and our team is a key driver of that effort. Previous team
members have grown into Technical Product Management roles based on the depth of
technical work here. If you want to solve complex optimization problems with
real operational impact, we would welcome you on the team. Basic Qualifications:

- Experience with product cycles of 6+ months
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights

senior stakeholders

Responsibilities

SOW Ownership & Implementation

Program Delivery & Execution

Client Success & Relationship Management

Financial Management

Reporting & Communication

Growth & Strategic Partnership

• Transition Management: Facilitate project transition and knowledge transfer while ensuring reporting, records retention, and future opportunity insights are documented and shared.

Continuous Improvement & Best Practices
• Process Improvement: Drive continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance project delivery methodologies, operational processes, and client outcomes.
• Scalable Solutions: Develop and promote scalable frameworks, templates, and best practices that foster consistency, efficiency, and a client-centric culture.

Qualifications & Skills
• Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience required; PMP certification preferred. 
• Experience: 8+ years of project or program management experience. Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare services, operations, or related industries preferred.
• Stakeholder Influence & Client Relationship Management: Proven ability to build trusted client relationships and influence stakeholders at all organizational levels.
• Leadership: Demonstrated success managing complex, cross-functional client engagements from initiation through completion.
• Coaching & Mentorship: Experience guiding and supporting direct report/team members to enhance performance and development.
• Strategic Thinking: Demonstrates the ability to align project execution with organizational objectives, proactively anticipate risks and opportunities, and develop solutions that drive long-term business and client value. 
• Change Management: Ability to embrace change and challenge the status quo to identify ways to work more efficiently and effectively.
• Agility: Demonstrates adaptability and resilience in a dynamic environment, effectively managing shifting priorities, evolving client needs, and changing business requirements while maintaining project momentum and delivery excellence.

In just over two years, we've gone from 0 to over 900 customers, succeeding where many have tried and failed before. We have a big mission: to make it wildly easier and more profitable to run and grow a renewables installation business – and through that to make a massive dent in the world's carbon emissions and create a hugely better experience for homeowners.

We're now looking for a Lead Product Designer to own design at Spruce: someone whose bar for craft is higher than ours, and who wants to set the standard for what our product looks and feels like as it gets more ambitious.




🌲 ABOUT SPRUCE

 - Almost 20% of the UK's carbon emissions comes from heating homes – there's simply no way to reach net zero without phasing out gas and oil boilers. Right now the only serious alternative is heat pumps, with their almost-magical ability to turn 1 kW of electricity into 3-5 kW of heat (🤯). But the heat pump installation journey is slow, inefficient, and just so painful. This makes it hard for existing installers to grow their businesses and puts off gas engineers from starting to do heat pumps. Perhaps most critically, it means you can't currently offer a heat pump when someone's boiler breaks and they urgently need heating.

 - We're fixing this. We've built a platform for heat pump installers to manage the whole installation journey from initial enquiry through to final compliance paperwork, freeing up their time to focus on what really matters: doing high-quality installations, providing great customer service, and scaling their business. Despite only getting started at the beginning of 2024, we're having a massive impact on installation businesses, suppliers, and manufacturers across the UK: halving the time they spend on each job and doubling their sales conversion rates.

 - We raised a chunky Seed round from top-tier investors and have been scaling the team to massively grow our impact. We're just about to launch solar and battery, and we're ultimately building the operating system for the whole home renewables supply chain. If you can picture a combination of ServiceTitan, Procore, and AutoCAD, you might get a sense of where we're headed…




🥖 THE ROLE

Our product handles building physics, fluid dynamics modelling and compliance – and is about to do a whole lot more. The job is to make all of that quick, intuitive and even delightful for a tradesperson who wants to spend as little time as possible at their desk. We've been design-led since the beginning, but the challenge is only growing as the product becomes (necessarily) more complex. Day-to-day you'll be:

 - Owning design at Spruce – Setting the design direction and standards across the product, deciding what good looks like, and building the practice (critique, tooling, rituals) that lets us keep shipping fast as the product and team grow. You'll work alongside our two product designers, raising the bar on their work as well as your own.

 - Doing the hardest design work yourself – This is a hands-on role. You'll take the gnarliest flows end to end: desktop design tools, homeowner-facing outputs, enquiry flows, mobile survey apps (incl. LiDAR), and collaborative workflows that work for everyone from a 3-person local installer to a national utility.

 - Collaborating closely with developers & shipping code yourself – Understanding data structures and technical constraints so your designs ship quickly; and shipping PRs yourself when it makes sense (with the support of the dev team).

 - Researching and validating – Spending time with installers on site to deeply understand how they work and what the core problems are; building quick prototypes to test decisions and uncover unexpected pain points.

You'll report directly to Steph, our Co-Founder and CPO.




🫵 ABOUT YOU

We're looking for a designer with 6+ years of product/UI design experience (and potentially much more), including time as the most senior designer on a product or team – ideally in a startup or a fast-moving, impact-focussed environment. We'd love to speak with you if you have:

 - Exceptional craft – You have a very high bar for UI execution and sweat the interaction details. You can point to work you'd happily put next to the best B2B products out there, and you can explain exactly why it's good.

 - A point of view – You hold strong design opinions, argue for them, and change your mind when the evidence says so. You'd rather be challenged than left alone.

 - Comfort in complexity – You're a clear, systematic thinker who enjoys technical detail, even in a domain that's new to you.

 - User obsession – You've run research with real customers yourself, not via a research team, and you've shipped things that measurably changed how they work.

 - Range – You're proactive and self-organising, happy running several projects at once and switching between strategy and pixels in the same afternoon.

Bonus if you've worked on tools for field teams, low-tech users, or operational workflows – but absolutely not a requirement.




🌟 OUR OFFER

 - 💰 We're looking for the best and will compensate accordingly

 - 🍰 Meaningful slice of equity (options) in the company

 - 🏖️ 33 days holiday and opportunity to work from abroad for another 30 days each year

 - 🏡 Hybrid working: 2–3 days in-person a week (London or Bristol), with full-team meetups every fortnight

 - 🏥 Private Medical Cover

 - 👧 Workplace Nursery Benefit scheme (YellowNest https://www.yellownest.co.uk/parent)

 - 🧑‍🍼 Enhanced Parental Leave

 - 🚲 Cycle to Work scheme

 - 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Brilliant team to learn from and massive opportunity to grow




🧑‍💻 WORKING AT SPRUCE

 - We're currently a close-knit team of 32, split between London and Bristol. We spend 2-3 days each week working together in-person in both locations, and get everyone altogether every fortnight.

 - You'll have genuine influence from day one. The best idea wins regardless of seniority. We expect you to challenge everything, ask "why?" multiple levels deep, and push back when something doesn't make sense.

At Anyscale, we're on a mission to democratize distributed computing and make it accessible to software developers of all skill levels. We’re commercializing Ray, a popular open-source project that's creating an ecosystem of libraries for scalable machine learning. Companies like OpenAI, Uber, Spotify, Instacart, Cruise, and many more, have Ray in their tech stacks to accelerate the progress of AI applications out into the real world.

With Anyscale, we’re building the best place to run Ray, so that any developer or data scientist can scale an ML application from their laptop to the cluster without needing to be a distributed systems expert.

Proud to be backed by Andreessen Horowitz, NEA, and Addition with $250+ million raised to date.

About the role:

We’re looking for an experienced alliance leader to grow Anyscale’s AWS business and maintain and advance our Neo Cloud partnerships, including CoreWeave, Nebius, and Crusoe. Reporting to the Head of Alliances, you’ll work closely with our Head of Sales, regional sales leaders, AEs, and Marketing to generate joint pipeline, expand opportunities, accelerate purchasing, and increase AWS Marketplace transactions. You will set the strategy and do the work yourself, from account mapping and deal support to agreement administration and partner follow through. 

You’ll also own our AWS Strategic Collaboration Agreement, building executive sponsorship and coordinating commitments, milestones, and benefits across both organizations. Post acquisition and integration with Nscale, our commitment to open source Ray and Neo Cloud Kubernetes environment remains the same. You'll translate that direction into partner plans, clear expectations, and coordinated support for customers.

What you’ll do:

 - Partner with regional sales leaders, AEs, and Marketing to build qualified AWS and Neo Cloud pipeline and help sellers expand opportunities, accelerate deal progression, and close business

 - Grow AWS Marketplace transactions by identifying suitable opportunities early and coordinating private offers, commercial requirements, and purchasing steps

 - Build partner engagement into regional sales cadences, ensuring eligible opportunities are registered and maintained in AWS ACE with clear owners and next steps

 - Own AWS Strategic Collaboration Agreement end to end: track obligations, milestones, benefit requirements, reporting, and escalate obstacles so we capture its full value

 - Lead executive engagement across AWS and Neo Cloud partners by preparing sponsors, aligning priorities, running business reviews, and driving follow-through

 - Own the AWS joint business plan, partner programs, and strategic initiatives, measuring pipeline, revenue, Marketplace adoption, and value delivered to the field

 - Work with Leadership, Product, Engineering, and Support on Neo Cloud joining opportunities and commitments

 - 8+ years experience in alliances, partnerships, or a related role at an enterprise software, cloud infrastructure, data or AI company

 - A positive track record of generating partner-sourced pipeline, revenue, and customer wins through AWS

 - Experience working directly with regional sales leaders, quota-carrying AEs, and Marketing

 - Hands on experience with AWS Marketplace transactions and managing opportunities through AWS ACE

 - Experience administering strategic cloud agreements and realizing their benefits

 - The ability to build executive sponsorship and manage sensitive partner relationships through organizational change or shifting competitive dynamics

 - Experience establishing practical processes, operating cadences, metrics, and cross-functional accountability

Technical

technologies to eliminate entire classes of issues, and drive the delivery of
security mitigations alongside our partner engineering teams. We design and
secure platforms for billions of users and are committed to user privacy and
security. We have some of the most creative, passionate, hardworking engineers

new, innovative ways of solving problems and to make software safer, easier, and
more fun to use. Not many jobs can offer all of these things. Security
engineering jobs at Apple do, and much more.

across Apple platforms. You will be working alongside a wide variety of teams

insightful analysis and creating innovative tools, consulting with other teams

security mitigations which will ship on billions of devices. This position

secure systems. Your responsibilities will include helping to make Apple's

optimisations. This is a high visibility role with opportunity to influence

hardware design.

- Previous experience in performance analysis of complex systems and

Be comfortable in an environment of uncertainty and able to work through

· Proven ability to provide effective strategic leadership at a senior level in challenging and time-sensitive contexts, including periods of reform or major change

Introduction to role:
Are you ready to architect enterprise-grade Tax and Treasury data models in SAP S/4HANA that power real-time decisions and ensure compliance at global scale? This role shapes the data foundations that enable precise tax reporting, resilient treasury operations and confident financial stewardship, ultimately helping us move life-changing medicines from bench to patient with pace and control.

As Data Design Expert for Tax and Treasury , you will design and govern Tax and Treasury data standards for our new ERP landscape, partnering closely with Finance, Tax, Treasury, IT, enterprise process teams and external consultants. Reporting to the R2R Data Design Lead -Tax and Treasury, you will translate complex requirements into coherent, scalable S/4HANA data models that align with SAP standards and downstream analytics. Could you see yourself guiding workshops that bring diverse stakeholders together to create clear, reusable designs that stand up to rigorous migration and ongoing operations?

Accountabilities:
• Enterprise Data Standards: Define, design, document and implement enterprise data standards for Tax and Treasury covering master, reference, transactional and metadata elements, ensuring clarity, consistency and long-term maintainability.
• End-to-End Data Model Ownership: Own the Tax and Treasury data model across SAP S/4HANA and integrated applications, ensuring alignment to business processes and downstream reporting needs from inception through deployment.
• Data Requirements and Quality: Establish detailed data requirements, mappings, standards, quality rules, ownership and migration specifications for key Tax and Treasury processes and objects, driving data that is complete, accurate and migration-ready.
• Tax Solution Landscape Integration: Lead data design for key tax domains and integrations, including:
• Indirect Tax: Integrations between SAP S/4HANA, Thomson Reuters ONESOURCE and SAP Document and Reporting Compliance (DRC).
• Direct Tax: Data requirements for provisioning, reporting and compliance, including integration of SAP S/4HANA with enterprise tax solutions such as Longview.
• Withholding Tax (WHT): S/4HANA WHT configuration and associated master, reference and transactional data.
• Transfer Pricing: Data design and integration supporting SAP Profitability and Performance Management (PaPM).
• Environmental Taxes: Data requirements enabling environmental tax processes and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) analytics.

Value Realisation and Benefits Tracking: Define and run the value-measurement discipline across all 17 products, tracking benefits against the run-cost bridge ($20.0M today to the $15.0M plan of record and the $13.5M stretch aim). Own the target of delivering a 10% productivity saving for each Core Function releasing time, effort and spend to be reinvested in higher-value work and evidence it product by product alongside the run-cost bridge, so the function sees a clear, auditable return on its IT investment.

Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits
Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Compliance and Risk Officer Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/ for apprentices in Scotland).

To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031).

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

Working In Northampton
Our environmentally friendly campus is designed with people in mind. With cafés, collaboration spaces, green spaces, wellbeing areas, parking, public transport links and a shuttle bus service, it’s a place where work feels good.

What happens once you apply?
Step 1 - We'll review your application
Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments
Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility
Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)
Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback.

Job Description

Purpose of the role
To design, develop and improve software, utilising various engineering methodologies, that provides business, platform, and technology capabilities for our customers and colleagues.

Accountabilities
• Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
• Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
• Collaboration with peers, participation in code reviews, and promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
• Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
• Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Analyst Expectations
• To meet the needs of stakeholders/ customers through operational excellence and customer service
• Perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard
• No people leadership roles at this grade.
• Execute work requirements as identified in processes and procedures, collaborating with and impacting on the work of team members.
• Identify escalation of policy breaches as required.
• Take responsibility for customer service and operational execution tasks.
• Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
• Gain and maintain an understanding of own role, how the team integrates to achieve overall objectives, alongside knowledge of the work of other teams within the function.
• Work within well-defined procedures that may involve a variety of work routines.
• Demonstrate an understanding of the procedures.
• Evaluate and select the appropriate alternatives from defined options.
• Make judgements based on the analysis of factual information.
• Build relationships with stakeholders and customers to identify and address their needs, in support of a smooth operating process, handling sensitive issues as required.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Annual Salary £25,200 + benefits
Getting qualified. It's a huge achievement that can completely change your prospects – but it’s not always open to everyone, whether that's due to the cost of university or the timing not being right. But with our apprenticeships, all that can change. Here at Barclays we offer a world-class programme that provides you with a permanent, full-time job with a competitive salary from day one - all whilst gaining a professional qualification at the same time. Whether you're a school-leaver looking for alternative options to the traditional university route or you're someone thinking differently about your future, we'll help you to build an extraordinary career at Barclays, no matter your background.

Our programme is designed for school leavers and career changers, but is open to anyone, no matter your background or your age. If you already have a degree, make sure you visit https://search.jobs.barclays/graduates and consider our graduate opportunities.

Why a Barclays Apprenticeship?
You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Digital & Technology Solutions Professional Degree Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. Due to the evolving nature of Apprenticeships, a new Apprenticeship might become available and if deemed more relevant to your role, we'll change the Apprenticeship before you start.

We’ve spent over a decade perfecting the support that you’ll receive on our Apprenticeship programme. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. We’ll also match you to an expert in your specialist subject, ready to share their knowledge.

The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. With over 325 years of expertise in Banking, Barclays operates in 39 countries, employing around 90,000 people to help move, lend, invest and protect money for customers and clients worldwide.

Why the Technology Developer Apprenticeship programme?
Technology Developers build and improve the systems that support Barclays. You’ll learn software engineering practices, collaborate with experienced teams and help create reliable, secure digital services.

Are you eligible?
First, you’ll need the right qualifications. For this apprenticeship opportunity you’ll need a minimum of 104 points at A2 (grades BCC) or an equivalent, e.g. BTEC DMM, plus GCSE Mathematics and English Language (grade A*-C / 9-4) or equivalent.

Beyond that though, we’re also looking for commitment and enthusiasm. Our Apprenticeships place deep investment in you as an individual. That means we need you to match that commitment: you’ll turn up every day ready to work hard, push yourself, and think differently about what you’re capable of.

To apply for our apprentice programme, you must meet the Government's apprentice funding requirements that apply to you (as outlined in https://www.gov.uk/ for apprentices in England and in https://www.saas.gov.uk/ for apprentices in Scotland).

The Government apprentice funding requirements include a number of requirements that you must meet, including a 3 year residence requirement (subject to certain exceptions). To qualify for the Government's apprentice funding requirements, you must also have the legal right to work for the full duration of the programme at the point of enrolment, with no gaps in your legal right to work or dependency on future visa applications during the period of your apprenticeship (August 2027 to August 2031).

You must also not have undertaken any previous study, education, training, qualifications, or apprenticeship, gained learning or competence from prior work experience, or received prior funding or financial support which renders you ineligible for the Government’s apprentice funding.

Working In Knutsford
Set in 64 acres of gardens and centred around historic Radbroke Hall, our Knutsford campus blends heritage with innovation. Colleagues enjoy a vibrant community with clubs, activities, shuttle buses and onsite parking.

What happens once you apply?
Step 1 - We'll review your application
Step 2 - You'll be asked to complete our online assessments
Step 3 - We'll ask you to complete a survey, so we can be sure of your eligibility
Step 4 - It's time to attend an in-person assessment day, where you'll be assessed during a group activity and interview (this will take place from October 2026)
Step 5 - We'll let you know the outcome and give you feedback.

You’ll get the opportunity to earn whilst working towards a Software Engineering Graduate Apprenticeship, a perfect blend of theoretical learning and real-life practical work whilst on a full-time salary in a permanent job. A unique chance to get a professional qualification without the student loan, all whilst getting years of work experience under your belt. From day one, you’ll be assigned a Programme Support Manager matched to your needs and background, and together with your People Leader, they’ll support you as an individual. The Apprenticeship route gives you the opportunity for self-discovery and helps you to explore different career paths. Accountabilities
• Development and delivery of high-quality software solutions by using industry aligned programming languages, frameworks, and tools. Ensuring that code is scalable, maintainable, and optimized for performance.
• Cross-functional collaboration with product managers, designers, and other engineers to define software requirements, devise solution strategies, and ensure seamless integration and alignment with business objectives.
• Collaboration with peers, participation in code reviews, and promotion of a culture of code quality and knowledge sharing.
• Adherence to secure coding practices to mitigate vulnerabilities, protect sensitive data, and ensure secure software solutions.
• Implementation of effective unit testing practices to ensure proper code design, readability, and reliability.

Analyst Expectations
• To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
• Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
• Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
• They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
• If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
• OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
• Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
• Partner with other functions and business areas.
• Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
• Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
• Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
• Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
• Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
• Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
• Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
• Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
• Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
• Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
• Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. Role Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced Trade & Working Capital originator and player-manager to lead our origination activity across Commodity clients, with additional responsibility for clients in the Diversified Energy and Infrastructure sectors.
The successful candidate will have a strong track record of originating, structuring, negotiating and executing complex trade and working capital transactions, with particular depth in commodity-related financing. They will combine strong client origination capabilities with excellent credit judgement and detailed product knowledge and will be comfortable leading transactions from initial client engagement and structuring through credit approval, documentation and execution.
This is very much a player-manager role. In addition to leading and developing a team of originators, the successful candidate will be expected personally to originate opportunities, lead important client discussions and take ownership of significant and complex transactions.
The role requires excellent stakeholder management skills working closely with Corporate Coverage and colleagues across Trade & Working Capital including Structuring and Syndications, Operations but also Credit, Product, Legal to identify opportunities and deliver financing solutions that meet clients' commercial requirements while demonstrating strong risk discipline to senior Credit/Risk stakeholders whilst generating appropriate returns for the bank.

Key Responsibilities
• Assume senior Trade & Working Capital origination responsibility for a defined portfolio of Commodity, Diversified Energy and Infrastructure clients, driving transaction origination, product penetration and income growth.
• Act as a player-manager, personally originating and leading material transactions while managing, mentoring and developing a team of originators (current team of 4).
• Build senior relationships with clients, particularly Trade Teams, Treasurers, CFOs and senior Finance and Procurement professionals, developing a detailed understanding of their businesses, working capital cycles, commodity flows and financing requirements.
• Originate, structure and execute bilateral and syndicated trade and working capital transactions, including trade loans, commodity prepayments, borrowing base, ECA backed structures and working capital facilities, non-recourse receivables and inventory financing, supply chain finance, letters of credit and guarantees.
• Develop financing structures appropriate to commodity-related businesses, taking account of underlying trade flows, collateral, commodity price movements, working capital cycles, contractual arrangements and associated credit risks.
• Lead complex transactions from initial identification through structuring, credit approval, negotiation, documentation and financial close, coordinating internal and external stakeholders to ensure effective execution.
• Work closely with Corporate Coverage Relationship Directors to identify opportunities across the existing client franchise and develop strategic Trade & Working Capital relationships.
• Partner effectively with Credit/Risk to develop financing structures which appropriately balance clients' commercial objectives with the bank's risk appetite and return requirements.
• Work closely with Product, Structuring, Syndications, Legal and Operations colleagues, ensuring appropriate internal resources are brought together to deliver complex transactions.
• Identify opportunities to deepen relationships and broaden product penetration across clients' wider working capital requirements, including receivables, payables, inventory and traditional trade instruments.
• Work across International Corporate Banking and with colleagues in other jurisdictions to originate and execute cross-border and multi-jurisdictional transactions.
• Maintain strong market awareness across commodity, energy and infrastructure sectors and use external networks, industry intelligence and existing client relationships to develop new opportunities.
• Help shape and execute the strategic agenda for the Trade & Working Capital business, representing the business at senior forums, client events and relevant industry conferences.
• Maintain consistently high standards of risk management, conduct and controls throughout the origination and execution process.

Person Specification

The successful candidate is likely to have significant relevant experience in Trade, Commodity Finance and/or Working Capital origination, with substantial experience working directly with corporate clients. They should demonstrate:
• A strong and demonstrable track record of originating and executing trade and working capital financing transactions for commodity-related businesses.
• Deep understanding of how commodity clients operate, including their physical trade flows, procurement and sales cycles, working capital requirements, liquidity drivers and financing structures.
• Strong credit skills and the ability to analyse complex transactions, identify the principal commercial and structural risks and develop appropriate mitigants.

Purpose of the role
The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities

• Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.

• Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.

Job Description

Purpose of the role
The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. Department: Nations Brand & Marketing

COULD A BBC APPRENTICESHIP BE THE NEXT ROLE FOR YOU?

Join us as an apprentice at the BBC to give yourself the opportunity to kick-start your career in a job you'll love. We’re committed to your skills and talent development. You’ll learn on-the-job, developing your knowledge and skills in an area that interests you, whilst working towards your apprenticeship qualification with one of our learning providers. 

WHY JOIN THIS SCHEME?

The BBC’s reach spans TV, radio, online, and beyond, and our marketing teams make sure every audience knows where to find the stories they love. As a Multi-Channel Marketer apprentice, you’ll learn how to plan, create, and deliver campaigns across digital, social, and traditional platforms, helping us connect with millions of people every day. Are you passionate about content, proactive and eager to learn about marketing? If the answer is ‘yes’ our Multi-Channel Marketer Level 3 Apprenticeship is for you!

Want to find out more? Watch recordings from our webinar series on our Life at the BBC YouTube playlist to learn more about this scheme and other opportunities we offer, and hear from current apprentices about their experiences.

WHY JOIN THE TEAM?

NI Marketing Team

This apprenticeship will build skills and experience in marketing within BBC Northern Ireland's Brand department. The apprentice will work as part of the Marketing team, alongside Media and Creative colleagues, supporting the delivery of campaigns for BBC Radio Ulster/Foyle, BBC Sport NI, BBC News NI, BBC iPlayer and BBC Sounds. They will gain experience across all stages of campaign delivery, from audience insight and planning through to content creation, digital marketing and campaign reporting. This is an ideal role for someone with a passion for marketing, creativity and audience engagement, who enjoys working with digital platforms and social media. There will also be opportunities to collaborate with colleagues across BBC Scotland, BBC Wales and network marketing teams in London and Salford.   

Scotland Marketing Team

The Scotland Brand marketing team to help shape and deliver a dynamic slate of brand and content campaigns for audiences in Scotland and across the UK.  We’re a creative, energetic, and strategic team that looks to foster expertise and grow experience within a culture that’s collaborative and forward thinking. We are focused on delivering compelling campaigns for BBC content that connects with our audiences in Scotland and across the UK.   As part of the Scotland brand marketing team, you’ll work across almost all BBC platforms, genres, and output to reach and engage our audiences. This includes everything from our ongoing news, sport and audio offers to a range of comedy, factual, drama, and entertainment content titles. 

YOUR KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND IMPACT

As a Multi-Channel Marketer (MCM27) apprentice, this is hands on chance to learn, grow, and contribute – you will:   

- Work with a BBC team to develop and deliver campaigns relevant to that team. 

- Contribute to the creation of brilliant content which will helps audiences engage with the BBC 

- Potentially analyse performance data to see what’s working, and help improve future campaigns. 

- Support the team with scheduling and campaigns, ensuring they are kept on track 

- Learn tools, techniques and strategies that contribute to world class marketing! 

You’ll study for your industry recognised apprenticeship qualification, learning both on and off the job.  This means you’ll spend at least one day a week studying for a Level 3 Multi-Channel Marketer apprenticeship with our learning provider, using its virtual delivery platform.       

For more information on what you will study during the scheme, please see the Multi-Channel Marketer standard**.**

YOUR SKILLS AND ELIGIBILITY

We’re interested in your passion for working at the BBC and your enthusiasm for delivering world-class content and operational excellence to our audiences. We’re not focused on your qualifications; instead, we look for potential and offer you the opportunity to apply your transferable strengths and experience to work in different ways. 

If you can bring some of these skills and experiences, along with transferable strengths, we’d love to hear from you and encourage you to apply:  

- Motivation - We want to see people who are passionate and curious about the BBC’s content, and what drives you to build a career in media marketing.  

- Creativity - If you are full of fresh ideas and eager to bring new perspectives to our marketing, we are keen to see how you’d bring that spark to the team!  

- Collaboration – Tell us about your ability to work well with others to reach a common goal. 

- Organisation – Hopefully you have a sharp eye for detail and the fundamental organisation needed to keep campaigns on track! 

- Adaptability – We’re looking for candidates with an ability to adapt to changing circumstances and working in uncertain situations! 

This scheme is aimed at non-graduates. If you have a degree and you’re interested in similar roles at the BBC, we recommend applying for jobs at the BBC careers site or having a look at our other apprenticeship schemes. 

ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA

To be eligible for an apprenticeship at the BBC, you must:  

- Be 18 years old or over by the time the apprenticeship begins in September 2027 

- Have lived in the UK continuously for the last 3 years prior to the start of the apprenticeship 

- Be legally eligible to work full-time in the UK for the entire duration of the apprenticeship 

- Not currently be enrolled in another apprenticeship programme, whether with the BBC or another organisation 

To apply for this scheme, you must also:  

- Not already hold a qualification in the same subject area (Marketing) at the same or a higher level than this apprenticeship. If you have a Marketing degree (the equivalent of Level 6), or a Marketing qualification at or above Level 3, you are not eligible for this role.  

For candidates under the age of 19 years at the start of the apprenticeship: To complete the apprenticeship, you must have achieved maths and English GCSE at Grade 4/C or above or National 5 (Scotland) at C or Functional Skills Level 2 or equivalent qualification.  If you have not achieved these qualifications by the start of your apprenticeship, you will be required to achieve Functional Skills Level 2 before the end of your apprenticeship when you take your end-point assessment.     

READY TO APPLY?

Don’t leave yourself wondering “what if?” this could be your chance to be part of something exciting. See yourself thriving in this role? Just click ‘Apply Now’!

job_title: Audio AI Research Scientist — Audio Source Separation
job_description:
At Bose Corporation, we believe sound is the most powerful force on earth — and for over 60 years, we have been a company built on innovation, excellence, and independence. Privately owned, fiercely customer-focused, and driven by our values, we continue to lead industries and transform lives through sound. 

Today, Bose Corporation is entering an exciting new era. Across multiple global Business Units and Global Functions, we are shaping the future of audio technology, automotive, luxury, and premium experiences. We invite you to join us in this transformation. 

Job Description

Research Scientist — Audio Source Separation

Description
The goal of our team is to develop novel AI-powered audio processing algorithms. The twist is that our algorithms must run in real time, on physical devices, for applications such as dynamic awareness, hearing augmentation, agentic perception, voice pickup, content enhancement, and ones we haven’t even thought of yet. You will work with experts in ML, DSP, software engineering, and psychoacoustics to prototype and implement new algorithms.
You will develop next-generation algorithms that isolate, extract, or suppress individual sound sources from microphone recordings, sometimes augmented by other sensor signals. Applications include voice pickup, hearing augmentation, and new audio experiences that must ultimately run in real time on physical devices.
Bose has a strong history of combining creative thinking with cutting-edge audio technology. We are looking for people passionate about machine learning and audio to help shape what comes next.

Responsibilities
· Research, prototype, train, and evaluate novel source separation and extraction algorithms for speech and other real-world sounds.
· Develop approaches for single- and multi-microphone recordings, including spatial cues and optional auxiliary sensors.
· Investigate robust separation in challenging conditions such as overlapping talkers, noise, reverberation, and motion.
· Evaluate perceptual quality, separation performance, generalization, latency, memory, and computational requirements.
· Collaborate with DSP and embedded software teams to deploy models in real-time demonstrations and product platforms; contribute to patents and conference papers.

Education
Graduate degree (MS or PhD) in machine learning, electrical engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent research experience.

Skills
· Deep hands-on experience in audio source separation, target sound extraction, speech enhancement, or related neural audio processing.
· Comfortable tackling complex, open-ended problems where you have to experiment with and discard many ideas before finding the right solution.
· Strong knowledge of audio DSP, time-frequency methods, and microphone array or spatial signal processing.
· Experience training and evaluating audio models in PyTorch; proficiency in Python and familiarity with C/C++ is a plus.
· Understanding of objective and perceptual evaluation methods and the tradeoffs involved in real-time low-power inference.
· Experience with multimodal or sensor-conditioned separation, ONNX/TFLite, or embedded deployment is a plus.
· Strong communication skills; publications at conferences such as ICASSP, Interspeech, NeurIPS, or similar are welcome but not required.

Are you a Criminal Solicitor looking for an opportunity to take your career in a different direction?
We’re looking for a Solicitor to join our Corporate Defence & Compliance team in Leeds. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with a background in criminal law who wants to build their experience in financial crime, corporate investigations and regulatory work.
For lawyers working in the legal aid criminal market, the CPS or criminal defence practice who enjoy the technical and investigative side of their work, this role offers the opportunity to build on that experience in complex financial and corporate matters.
What will you be doing?
Our Corporate Defence & Compliance team advises individuals and businesses facing investigations by law enforcement, regulatory and investigatory bodies.
You’ll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced lawyers on complex, high-profile and often sensitive matters, including:
• Fraud and financial crime investigations

• Money laundering and proceeds of crime matters

• Sanctions-related matters

• Internal corporate investigations including bribery, fraud and corporate misconduct investigations

• Competition and cartel investigations

• Compliance and preventative advisory work

The work is varied, with opportunities to work alongside colleagues across Brabners on complex multi-disciplinary matters that bring together criminal, regulatory, civil and corporate issues.
Although the team is based in Leeds, the work is national, with opportunities to support matters involving clients and issues across different areas.
What are we looking for?
We’re particularly interested in hearing from Solicitors with around 1 to 3 years’ PQE who have built their foundations in criminal law and are now looking to develop a specialism in financial crime.
Your experience might come from criminal defence, whether private or legal aid, the CPS, or a similar criminal law background. Experience attending police stations, representing clients at court or working as a Duty Solicitor would be particularly valuable.
More importantly, we’re looking for someone who is:
• Technically strong and comfortable getting into the detail

• Experienced in dealing with criminal investigations and procedure

• Curious and keen to develop their knowledge of financial crime

• Comfortable working collaboratively on complex matters

• Looking to build a long-term career within corporate defence, investigations and compliance

You don’t need to already be a financial crime specialist. We’re looking for someone with strong criminal law foundations who we can support and develop into one.
Why this opportunity?
This isn’t simply another criminal law role.
It’s an opportunity to take the skills you’ve already developed as a criminal lawyer and apply them within a different environment, working on financial crime, regulatory and corporate investigations.
You’ll join a collaborative team where matters regularly overlap across different specialisms, giving you the opportunity to learn from experienced lawyers and develop a broad understanding of financial crime and corporate defence work, including financial services and tax.
If you’re a criminal solicitor who enjoys the investigative and technical side of the job but is ready to develop a new specialism, we’d really like to hear from you.

We’re hiring the first cohort of Forward Deployed Engineers to bring it into production at enterprise customers. You’ll own the deployment journey from first process file to a working, improving system, and hand off a functioning capability to the customer’s team. The code you write and the patterns you discover feed directly back into how ProcessOS is built. This is a rare opportunity to shape a product, a function, and a field practice from day one.


You’ll work end‑to‑end across Java services and React interfaces, collaborating closely with a talented global team to measure, improve, and scale performance and fault tolerance in real-world distributed systems.

 - Feed the product. Custom agents you write get contributed back. Integration patterns get codified. Production bugs you find, you often fix. Your field work is a direct input to ProcessOS.

 - Familiarity with regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or insurance

• Develop pitch decks, product and solution playbooks, battlecards, objection handling and training materials.

• Onboard new commercial hires on Captify's offering, positioning and competitive landscape.

Your Work Shapes the World at Caterpillar Inc. 
When you join Caterpillar, you're joining a global team who cares not just about the work we do – but also about each other. We are the makers, problem solvers, and future world builders who are creating stronger, more sustainable communities. 12 Month Industrial Placement Scheme
Discipline: Manufacturing Engineering
Location: Desford, UK
Salary: £26,000, Share Scheme, Pension, Flexible working, and 27 days annual leave (plus bank holidays)
At Caterpillar, you build what matters—whether it’s the career you want, crucial work skills, strong relationships, or new technologies. Our work is powered by our people.
*Please note that in order to be eligible to complete a 12-Month Industrial Placement commencing July 2027, you must be in your penultimate year of study unless enrolled in an integrated master’s program.
What do we do?
Caterpillar Inc. is the world’s leading manufacturer of construction and mining equipment, diesel and natural gas engines, industrial gas turbines, and diesel-electric locomotives. Since 1925, we’ve been driving sustainable progress and helping customers build a better world through innovative products and services. Throughout the product life cycle, we offer services built on cutting-edge technology and decades of product expertise. These products and services, backed by our global dealer network, provide exceptional value to help our customers succeed.
We have a clear vision to be the global leader in providing customer value in the markets in which we operate. Our core values (Integrity, Excellence, Teamwork, Commitment and Sustainability) are key to our success.
Caterpillar’s Desford facility is part of the Building Construction Products (BCP) division, manufacturing a range of world class Backhoe Loaders and Compact Wheel Loaders, as part of the wider BCP range of products. Desford is more than just a production facility – it is home to a range of functions with global scope, including HR, Finance, Engineering, Purchasing, Manufacturing and Marketing. 

Diversity at Caterpillar
When we leverage our people's experiences, backgrounds, and cultures in an inclusive environment, we enable every individual to achieve their full potential, which drives business success. We are proud to be active partners with both the Society of Women Engineers (SWE) & Women's Engineering Society (WES). We also have numerous well supported employee resource groups. Caterpillar is an equal opportunity employer, and we welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds. 
What experiences can we offer you?
As an equal opportunity employer, we value diversity at Caterpillar and believe the more experience you can gain early in your career the further you can go. That’s why during our yearlong scheme we place an emphasis on multiple diverse projects. You will have the opportunity to work and collaborate with people in Caterpillar facilities worldwide and we are looking for you to bring fresh, innovative ideas to solve complex technical problems. You will be a fully involved team member with responsibility and accountability for key project deliverables. That said, you will be given all the support you require to be successful.
Our placement roles have the additional benefit of a workplace mentor; this could be your manager or a technical expert who will support you throughout your time at Caterpillar and help you gain the professional development and skills you need to be set up for success! Our placement students can expect to return to university with further developed technical skills and experience of how University learning is applied to the workplace.
We also operate a conditional offer process; our highest performing placement students are fast tracked to our graduate development scheme. This includes a financial incentive and the potential of a summer work placement. Offers will be made based on the condition that a graduate role is available at the time of your graduation and that you achieve a min of 2:1.
Job duties and responsibilities may include but are not limited to:
Support manufacturing improvement projects on our Electric and Combustion powered vehicles, driving Safety, Quality, Velocity & Cost using 6 Sigma Methodologies.
Work with the latest Manufacturing Engineering Technologies to introduce our New Products, evaluating design for assembly & automation feasibility, generating manufacturing processes and documentation, allowing our latest machines to be produced to our world class manufacturing standards.
Utilise CAD software to design new equipment, complete virtual builds and develop facility layouts in line with Caterpillars Production System.
Implement new equipment/tooling to production, inc. Design, budgeting, evaluation, procurement, implementation, training and sign off.
Create and review associated process risk documentation; PFMEA, Control Plans and SFMEA’s to drive safety improvements in new and current processes.
Work with Additive Manufacturing, Robotics & Automation (assembly and inspection), AI, Digital Twins, Measurement Analysis & Machine Validation Equipment.
Complete root cause analysis for quality improvement opportunities and implement robust process containment measures.
Support and implement sustainability projects within the manufacturing process, ensuring alignment with Caterpillar’s commitment to environmental responsibility
Adhere to the company's Health and Safety policy and safe working practices.
Adhere to Caterpillar's Values in Action: Integrity, Commitment, Excellence, Teamwork, & Sustainability.
We hold a Meet and Greet day for all new UK placement students to provide you with an opportunity to meet fellow new starters across the UK before you start your placement.
Who are we looking for?
As the type of roles within our business are becoming more diverse, we are looking for people who are open minded, excellent problem solvers and who have an ability to learn quickly. You will be motivated, hard-working, and will embrace change. In return for your dedication and hard work, you will be provided with excellent career opportunities and strong support for your personal and career development to pursue a career within Caterpillar.
Applicants will be on target to achieve a minimum of 2:1 honour degree level in one of the following disciplines:
Mechanical Engineering
Manufacturing Engineering
Mechatronics/Robotics
Automation and Control Engineering
Systems Engineering
Automotive Engineering
Desirable Skills:
Data analysis and reporting
Statistics and data science
Data visualisation
Computing technology
Software development
Recruitment Process Guidelines:
We’re excited that you’re considering a career with Caterpillar. Below is an overview of our Early Careers recruitment process and what you can expect at each stage.
Step 1 – Online Application: To apply, simply complete our online application form and upload your CV before the advertised closing date. Our team will review all submissions, and we’ll keep you updated and let you know as soon as possible if you’ve been selected to progress to the next stage.
Step 2 – Online Assessments & Video Interview: If you are selected to move forward in the process, you’ll be invited to complete some online assessments, followed by a user-friendly video interview. Your responses will be reviewed by the hiring team, and successful candidates will then be invited to attend an in-person Assessment Centre, which we anticipate will take place on Thursday 28th January at our Desford facility. If possible, we recommend keeping this date available.
To ensure you don’t miss any communications from us, please regularly check your text, email inbox (including your spam/junk folder) and your Workday account for updates.
Step 3 – In Person Assessment Centre: Our Assessment Centre is designed to help you showcase your potential through a range of interactive activities focused on competencies such as teamwork, communication, problem-solving and decision-making.
We aim to make the experience engaging, inclusive, and relaxed, giving you the best opportunity to demonstrate your strengths and learn more about Caterpillar.
Step 4 – Offer: Following the Assessment Centre, the Caterpillar team will review all feedback to make hiring decisions. We aim to communicate outcomes and extend offers to successful candidates as quickly as possible.
Placement students will begin their placement on 5th July 2027.
NOTE: Only one application is required, please do not apply for multiple roles. You may be given the opportunity of being considered for other roles/locations at a later stage.

CFC’s Data & AI unit is building production agentic systems that automate complex underwriting decisions - not chatbots, not copilots bolted onto legacy workflows, but autonomous multi-step AI agents that reason over unstructured data, assess risk, and drive real business outcomes.
